findings.problem: Mutable options.scope could reset the captured policy; concatenated scope/identity strings collided.
findings.change: Snapshot all options and serialize scope/identity tuples; freeze nested presets and retain compatible user/IP alias.
findings.limit: Scope mutation is an application-state invariant, not a demonstrated external exploit. Existing numerical quotas unchanged.

findings.problem: No bound on active keys; expiry cleanup could not bound high-cardinality active traffic.
findings.change: Default 10,000 active buckets per policy/owner, configurable maxKeys. At capacity new keys receive 503 RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After; preserve existing counters. Expiry heap supports deadline order independently of insertion order.
findings.limit: Per-policy/owner cardinality bound, not a byte/process-wide bound. Fail-closed capacity can temporarily deny new clients; deployment sizing remains required.

findings.problem: Two clock reads could emit Retry-After=0; unsafe integer/configuration values were accepted.
findings.change: One request time snapshot; positive Retry-After; validate safe positive counters/window/capacity and expiry arithmetic, status range, header/message/key/scope contracts. Reject invalid generated keys before storage. Saturate denied counters.

review.caller_trace: Static limiter/preset/keyer callers traced across modules; actual global scope/owner/onClose in server and representative cart, checkout and newsletter hooks read. This is not every route/module review.
review.storage: Weak owner registry, one bounded store per policy; expiry min-heap, no interval/sweeper handle; prune on requests, explicit idempotent owner disposal. Expired entries can remain idle until next request/disposal, still bounded.
review.preserved: Fixed-window quotas, route/method or explicit scope, IP/user identity names, custom quota message/status and optional headers retained. Authentication credential 401 falls back to IP; infrastructure failure still propagates. Frozen preset values unchanged.
